newsitem.title: USA: US expansion has long way to go-Treasury's Summers.
newsitem.headline: US expansion has long way to go-Treasury's Summers.

text.p: The U.S. economic expansion has a long way to run, Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said on Thursday.
"I'm very confident that the expansion has a long way to run," he told CNBC television. "I feel very good about where the economy is."
Inflation is under control, the budget deficit has fallen sharply and will likely drop further, and investment is up, he said.
